name: RawTrampis
description:
RawTrampis Pro v4.2.0 is Trampis’ Geometry Dash toolkit for configurable practice, gameplay analysis, and a polished animated interface. This update repairs theme switching and tab navigation, makes the RawTrampis tab strings resolve correctly across language packs, restores working search in both supported renderers, and adds four new high-contrast palettes.

OPENING AND NAVIGATING
Press Ctrl+N to open or close the menu (the shortcut can be changed in Keybinds). The menu is made of independently movable and resizable category panels. Use each panel’s scroll area to browse its controls and the small settings arrow beside supported features to open feature-specific options. The RawTrampis home tab provides a searchable feature list, theme selection, optional search autofocus, a clear-search action, and a one-click reset to RawTrampis Blue. Search matches feature names, descriptions, and IDs across categories; clearing the query restores the full menu.

THEME AND INTERFACE OPTIONS
Choose RawTrampis Blue, Aurora, Flame, Emerald, Rose, Catppuccin Macchiato, Gruvbox, MegaHack, MegaOverlay, or OpenHack from the theme selector. Theme selection changes the palette and component styling while preserving the active renderer and layout, so switching colors does not unexpectedly rebuild the menu or make tabs inaccessible. Bundled themes request the animated background blur; blur is applied where the active renderer and graphics path support it. Interface controls remain available for layout, component style, scale, DPI scaling, fonts, blur strength/speed, and animated window behavior. Theme choice and appearance settings persist between launches.

CATEGORIES
Global groups general gameplay and session tools, including audio, speed, display-rate, cursor, list, and safety controls. Level contains level-specific practice, progress, pause, coin, trigger, and visual tools. Player contains Noclip and player movement, click, jump, trail, and effect features. Bot contains automation, replay, and practice helpers. Creator provides editor-oriented tools. Labels contains configurable on-screen information and the optional cheat indicator. Shortcuts offers quick actions. Keybinds manages the menu shortcut and supported feature bindings. Interface configures presentation and accessibility. Internal Recorder provides recording and replay controls when its optional integration is present. The available categories and options may vary with platform and optional dependencies.

FEATURE SETTINGS AND PRACTICE
RawTrampis retains the upstream implementations and per-feature option panels instead of presenting cosmetic placeholder controls. Where supported, open the feature’s settings arrow to configure its keybind, mode, thresholds, display behavior, or gameplay conditions. Noclip is off by default and uses hazard-focused collision handling so ordinary platforms remain solid. The cheat indicator is optional and configurable; it does not display unless enabled. Feature enablement and individual settings are saved according to their configuration behavior. Some features intentionally have no extra settings.

COMPATIBILITY AND RESPONSIBLE USE
The current target is Geometry Dash 2.2081 with Geode 5.11.2. Future game, Geode, graphics-driver, or third-party mod updates may affect compatibility. Gameplay options can alter movement, timing, progression, or displayed results. Use them only where permitted; assisted attempts may not qualify for records or leaderboards. RawTrampis does not claim modified attempts are legitimate or leaderboard-eligible.

SOURCE, LICENSE, AND SAFETY
This project is based on Eclipse Menu source distributed under the Eclipse Public License 2.0; license and attribution files are included. The arbitrary user-selected DLL loading feature is omitted because it would execute external code inside the game process. Optional integrations are limited to their documented functions. No mod can guarantee compatibility with every unrelated mod or future game update.
